name: Easey AI
author: Easey AI

sections.description:
A next-gen content management system that empowers WordPress users with headless architecture for unparalleled flexibility and control over their web content.

Source Code

The unminified source code for Tailwind CSS is included in the assets/styles/ directory as tailwind.css.

Alternatively, you can find the original source code at Tailwind CSS GitHub Repository.

Instructions on how to build and customize Tailwind CSS are available in the repository.
sections.installation:
The easiest way to install the plugin is to use the plugins management page in your administration panel.

Also, the package can be downloaded manually and unzipped in the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

When resources have been copied, the plugin can be activated by looking for an “Easey AI” entry in the plugins page and clicking on “Activate”.

Configure the options through Settings->Easey AI.

Clicking on the “Deactivate” button will disable the user profile fields and the post editing box information associated with the plugin. The “Delete” button will remove any Easey AI related field in the database.
